name: OnaFlix Data Pipeline
postCreateCommand: go mod download && psql -U postgres -c "CREATE USER gitpod WITH PASSWORD 'gitpod' CREATEDB;" && psql -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE onaflix OWNER gitpod;" && psql -U gitpod -d onaflix -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS movies (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, release_year INT, rating NUMERIC, image_url TEXT, director TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());"
